scope: Release check matrix on a clean checkout of the candidate commit: unit, governance, backend, build, generated output and the three browser gates. Scripted browser input on the shared engine; no human playtest, no FPS or playtime measure, no art or story acceptance.

checkout.method: git clone of the repository into a new directory, detached at the candidate SHA, with the installed dependencies linked in because this environment has no network. The source checkout was not modified by the verification.

regressions.note: The 1A run measured 7 architecture runs with 1966 frames and 0 collisions on the hardware renderer. The candidate must show the same green result on a clean checkout of its own SHA.

limits: The candidate commit was verified locally. It was not pushed, not deployed and not run on a hosted CI runner.
The browser gates are scripted movement checks. They are not a human playtest, an FPS measurement or a playtime claim.
G3/G4 stay unapproved; no art, story or campaign acceptance is implied by this evidence.
Heavy artefacts (images, traces, logs) stay in outputs/agent-work/pr04-1d and are not committed.
